name: Nickel
occurrence: Concentrated in Earth's core (thought to make up much of it alongside iron); mined from sulfide and laterite ores.
majorUses: Rechargeable NiMH and older NiCd batteries
safetyNotes: Nickel is one of the most common causes of metal contact allergy, responsible for a large share of jewellery-related skin reactions.
notableCharacteristics: One of the four ferromagnetic elements and, alongside iron, believed to make up the bulk of Earth's solid inner core.
whyHere: Its eight 3d electrons leave it just two short of a filled d-subshell, giving strong metallic bonding and the ferromagnetic alignment it shares with iron and cobalt.
didYouKnow: Nickel is thought to make up a significant fraction of Earth's solid inner core alongside iron — the reason the core is often called the 'iron-nickel core'.
genZNote: Quietly makes up Earth's core and also your 'silver' coins. Understated but structurally essential, literally.
